title: App Store header (iOS 27), C: A week of looks
brief: Direction C of the iOS 27 App Store product-page header (21:9, 3840 × 1646) and search card (3:2, 2880 × 1920): a 15 s muted loop. Monday to Sunday, a look from Emma's own wardrobe each day, laid flat on its own fashion-campaign colour set; the close is the whole week as seven cards, "A look for every day." and the Curate lockup. Two variants: c1 flip (each day the whole frame, the next set pushes in) and c2 rail (the sets as cards on a rail, the camera gliding a card a step). The founder asked for colour on this header (2026-10-24, "a bit more colorful").
hook: 0–1 s: Monday's look, laid flat on cobalt paper, the day's name big; the line at 0.9 s.
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona; her wardrobe pieces are product cut-outs of her own (AI-generated) clothes.

gateLog.note: Mechanical gate: every listed asset is approved in the catalog (30 garment cut-outs, the lockup, Geist, the track); no app screens, no generated media.

brief, style guide, shot list; full-size stills per shot in out/g2/week-c1|c2[-search]/ (subtle, handed in) and week-c1|c2-bold/ (kept). Critic rounds 1-3: c1 subtle 8/8/8/8/8 (r2), c2 subtle 8/8/8/8/8 (r3), sound n/a (muted).
